Overview.Name: Sriram Nedunuri
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating

Meal_1 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (100 g) & vegetable curry + curd
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & vegetable curry & curd (200 g)
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + paneer cubes (80 g)
Meal_2 (Dinner - controlled): Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & paneer cubes (80 g) + vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & vegetable curry & buttermilk

Notes_and_Tips: Start meals with paneer or curd before eating rice to reduce overeating.
For stress cravings, pause for 10 minutes before taking extra food.
Avoid fried and outside foods as they trigger loss of control.
Keep meals simple and consistent to reduce decision fatigue.
Managing stress and sleep will directly improve craving control.
